title: Buildings built in minutes — SfM + NeRF reconstruction
description: A dual-pipeline 3D reconstruction system: classical Structure-from-Motion for precise pose estimation paired with Neural Radiance Fields for dense photorealistic view synthesis from sparse image inputs.

stats.label: PSNR
stats.detail: nerf render · and 0.411 px SfM reprojection error · sub-pixel accuracy

extraText: Reconstructed photorealistic 3D models of large-scale architecture from only 2D image sequences, navigating the trade-offs between geometric accuracy (SfM's strength) and photorealistic rendering (NeRF's strength) for complex urban scenarios.
Engineered the classical front-end with COLMAP for SfM pose recovery, then the neural back-end with coordinate-based MLPs for NeRF volumetric rendering. Integrated through PyTorch.
Outperformed baselines on high-frequency details and complex non-Lambertian lighting — shiny surfaces, reflections, and specular materials — which break simpler reconstruction methods.
